question: The current population of a town is 12,500. It increases by 52% and 30% in two successive years but decreases by 15% in the third year. What is the population of the town at the end of the third year?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net Population = Initial Base × Successive Multiplying Factors

Final Population = 12500 × (100 + 52)% × (100 + 30)% × (100 − 15)%

Final Population = 12500 × 1.52 × 1.30 × 0.85

Final Population = 19000 × 1.30 × 0.85 = 24700 × 0.85 = 20995

**∴ The correct answer is 20,995.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial Population (P) = 12,500

Successive changes over three years: +52%, +30%, and −15%

**Formula Used:**

Final Value = P × (1 ± R₁/100) × (1 ± R₂/100) × (1 ± R₃/100)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Population at the end of Year 1 = 12500 × (1 + 52/100)

⇒ Population at the end of Year 1 = 12500 × 152/100 = 19000

⇒ Population at the end of Year 2 = 19000 × (1 + 30/100)

⇒ Population at the end of Year 2 = 19000 × 130/100 = 24700

⇒ Population at the end of Year 3 = 24700 × (1 − 15/100)

⇒ Population at the end of Year 3 = 24700 × 85/100 = 20995

**∴ The correct answer is 20,995.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

When a value is changed successively by a% and b%, the net percentage change is given by the formula: Net Change = (a + b + a×b ÷ 100)%.

Final Value Formula

For successive changes over multiple periods, the final value is calculated as: Final Value = Initial Value × (1 ± r₁/100) × (1 ± r₂/100) × ...

Population Depreciation

If a population or machine value decreases by a constant rate of r% every year, the value after n years is calculated using P(1 − r/100)ⁿ.
